title: 3,000 feet up, a slab let go: Zion's Cable Mountain, 2019 #Shorts
description:
Three thousand feet up, a slab of sandstone let go. August twenty-fourth, twenty nineteen: rock broke off Cable Mountain, above Weeping Rock. More than four hundred and thirty-five thousand cubic feet of debris came down. Three visitors were hurt. Part of a trail was buried under what geologists called a small rock avalanche. The twist? Nearly a century earlier, that same mountain had lowered the lumber for Zion Lodge on a wire.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 2: The Day the Mountain Fell: Zion's Lost Lake): https://youtu.be/1KUANk1uGtU

#Shorts #Zion #Rockfall #CableMountain #NationalParks
